# DELAUNAY BOOK

> Color as a Generative Principle in the Work of Sonia Delaunay.
> A multilingual scholarly publication by Nicholas Van-Orton.

## Overview

DELAUNAY BOOK is an independent publishing initiative presenting
a scholarly study of colour as a generative and organising
principle in the work of Sonia Delaunay.

The publication examines the development of colour from a
physical phenomenon and perceptual experience toward an
autonomous principle of artistic and visual organisation.

Its interdisciplinary perspective connects art history,
scientific colour theory, modern painting, textile design,
digital imaging, and generative art.

Nicholas Van-Orton is identified on the website as an independent

## Main Publication

Title:
Color as a Generative Principle in the Work of Sonia Delaunay

Author:
Nicholas Van-Orton

Primary language:
English

Subject:
The role of colour in artistic structure, visual perception,
modern art, textile design, and generative visual practices.
